name: Jumping jack

phases.name: together
phases.cue: Stay light on the balls of your feet

formTips: Land softly on the balls of your feet with your knees a little bent
Swing your arms all the way up until your hands are above your head
Jump your feet out to just wider than your shoulders
Keep your chest up and your core braced
commonMistakes: Landing heavily on flat feet or locked knees
Only raising the arms to shoulder height
Leaning forward or letting the back arch
